name: tiered-headings-navigator
description: Navigate and fold user-defined, tiered inline headings in text documents.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Literal heading navigation remains available, but labelRegex transformations are disabled until the workspace is trusted.

tieredHeadings.triggers.markdownDescription: Literal snippets that define heading levels and pane labels. Use `${after}`, `${before}`, `${line}`, `${trigger}`, or `${lineNumber}` in `labelTemplate`. Optional `labelDelimiters` or `labelRegex` transform `${after}` before formatting.

snippet.description: Literal text that marks a heading line.

level.description: Heading level. Level 1 is the highest tier.

labelTemplate.description: Template used to create the heading label.

labelDelimiters.description: Exact, case-sensitive delimiters stripped atomically from text after the trigger.

labelRegex.markdownDescription: A case-sensitive Unicode JavaScript regular-expression replacement applied once to text after the trigger, before `labelTemplate`. Disabled in Restricted Mode. Do not combine with `labelDelimiters`.

pattern.description: Regular-expression source. Backslashes must be escaped for JSON.

replacement.markdownDescription: Replacement text using JavaScript replacement syntax, including `$1`, `$<name>`, and `$$`. May be empty.

tieredHeadings.caseSensitive.description: Match trigger snippets using case-sensitive comparison.

tieredHeadings.gutter.enabled.description: Show a gutter marker beside detected heading lines.

tieredHeadings.folding.enabled.description: Provide native editor folding ranges for detected headings.

tieredHeadings.folding.syncFromNavigator.markdownDescription: When enabled, collapsing or expanding a parent heading in the **Headings** view folds or unfolds its editor section. This synchronization is one-way and requires custom heading folding, `editor.folding`, and the `auto` folding strategy.

tieredHeadings.editor.decorateOnlyTitle.markdownDescription: Apply heading font styles only to source text contributing to the **Headings** label instead of the whole line. Removed delimiters and regex text are excluded; generated label text has no editor decoration. Gutter markers are unaffected.

tieredHeadings.editor.levelStyles.markdownDescription: Font styles for detected heading levels. Applied to the whole line unless `tieredHeadings.editor.decorateOnlyTitle` is enabled. Unlisted levels are unchanged; use an empty array to disable heading text styling.

style.description: Font style applied to the detected heading line or its title, according to editor.decorateOnlyTitle.

scripts.compile:all: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests && vscode-test --label stable
scripts.test:integration:minimum: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests && vscode-test --label minimum
scripts.check: npm run check-types && npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:integration && npm run test:integration:minimum
